evidence: NESTING ARITHMETIC (verified, all values byte-identical to the frozen template). task.toml:18 [agent] timeout_sec = 7200.0; :21 build_timeout_sec = 600.0; :27 [verifier] timeout_sec = 13200.0. tests/test.sh:207 runs every suite with `rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1` (judges inside a suite run sequentially, so the SUM of judge timeouts is the binding quantity); :213 `run_suite gates 1500`; :224 `run_suite scored 11100`. Judge timeouts: gates/render/judge.toml:4 timeout = 600, gates/constraints/judge.toml:4 timeout = 600, scored/functional/judge.toml:4 timeout = 9000, scored/polish/judge.toml:4 timeout = 900, scored/visual/judge.toml:4 timeout = 900. Gates: each 600 < 1500, sum 1200 < 1500 (300 s headroom). Scored: each < 11100, sum 9000+900+900 = 10800 < 11100 (300 s headroom). Budgets: 1500 + 11100 = 12600 < 13200 (600 s headroom for cp of /app, the liveness loop, prompt substitution and two score.py runs). Liveness: test.sh:116-122 120 x 0.25 s sleep with 2 s urlopen timeouts (~30 s for a refused/fast port; worst case on hanging sockets ~510 s, still inside the 600 s verifier headroom, and it runs before the gate budget starts). Restart: generated helper waits 120 x 0.25 s (test.sh:171-182) inside restart_mcp.py HELPER_TIMEOUT_SEC = 55 (tools/restart_mcp.py:11), which sits inside the 9000 s functional judge. tests/test.sh SHA256 bd682592... equals the template test.sh; tests/tools identical to template (diff -r empty); task.toml differs from the template only in [task]/[metadata] identity text, timeouts identical to staged-task-contract.md:54-63,111. Agent image (environment/Dockerfile) is node:22-bookworm-slim + small apt set + npm -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (prebuilt binary) - a realistic cold build well under 600 s, but not measured here. Agent 7200 s is the canonical value for a hard full-stack build; no agent run measured. 'LONG ENOUGH' HALF (unmeasured). The functional dimension has 43 criteria (grep '[[criterion]]' count) judged in one batched claude-code session driven by a 12.6 KB prompt with 13 multi-context protocols (Z,S,M,L,C,B,N,T,U,V,A,D plus a backend check), many independent browser contexts, several 15-second no-touch waits (U, V) and one restart. Whether GLM-5.3-flashx through claude-code finishes that within 9000 s, and whether the 600 s constraints gate (create job + candidate + independent Observer context) finishes reliably, has not been measured: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent' and every entry is 'Not a configured judge run ... or judge-duration measurement'. The scripted golden (results/workspace.json, 18 groups all passed) is not judge duration (REVIEW_POLICY.md:25). Per SKILL.md 'Never upgrade an unmeasured claim to Pass', the row cannot be Pass. Mitigation present: every prompt instructs NOT EXERCISED - evaluator/tool limitation on exhausted budget (gates/*/prompt.md:11, polish:18, visual:16), but a suite-level `timeout` kill at test.sh:213/224 returns non-zero and exits with the zero reward, so a too-short budget would attribute a harness failure to the submission. Adversarial probes: (a) a broken app cannot exploit the timeouts - a slow/hanging app only consumes judge time and earns NOT EXERCISED zeros, and liveness failure yields zero; (b) a conforming but slow-rendering or many-context-heavy app could push the sequential functional session past 9000 s or the constraints gate past 600 s, collapsing to reward 0 (gate kill) or losing late protocols (A, D restart run last) - plausible, unmeasured. No timeout change is warranted or authorized without a full configured timing measurement (REVIEW_POLICY.md:25; AGENTS.md).
counterexample: Unmeasured, not demonstrated: a correct golden-equivalent app judged by claude-code/glm-5.3-flashx where the 43-criterion functional session (13 protocols, multiple independent contexts, 15 s waits, restart last) exceeds the 9000 s judge timeout, or the 600 s constraints gate times out; test.sh:213 then exits with ZERO_REWARD_JSON, scoring a conforming submission 0.
suggested_fix: No config change now (nesting is correct and template-frozen). Obtain a full configured verifier run (test.sh as shipped, configured judge) on the golden and record per-judge wall-clock for gates/constraints, gates/render and scored/functional against 600/600/9000 s; only if it is close to the limit, reduce functional browser work or seek an authorized, recorded timeout change below five hours.
